worldcombat.skill.constrict.summary: Creeping vines or tentacles crawl out step by step at the user's pace along the chosen direction, and the first foe this line touches is the one that gets wrapped; walls stop it and an empty reach retracts. The damage is tiny; the value is what comes after — a Speed drop and a brief hold, handing the target to an ally or to the user's next move. The latch form also keeps a vine joining both ends that can be torn apart or cut off by a wall.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.use.1: Pin a foe in place for an ally
worldcombat.skill.constrict.use.2: Leave a lasting slow on a foe at the lowest cost
The tendril reaches out step by step at %3$s blocks per tick along the chosen direction, up to %2$s blocks; the first foe the line touches takes about %1$s points of contact damage and is bound. A wall stops it and an empty reach retracts, neither dealing damage.

A bound target loses %1$s Speed stages and stays wrapped for %2$s seconds (about 30% lower movement speed); it is also rooted for %3$s seconds and cannot move. There is a %4$s chance to tighten for one more Speed stage.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.latch.on: Latch form: binds and holds far longer and drops one more Speed stage, and keeps a vine joining both ends — pulling past the reach by 0.9 blocks or a solid wall between snaps it at once and ends this instance's bind. But it deals less damage and the user commits limbs to hold it, unable to move for a moment.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.latch.off: Squeeze form: a heavier, quicker crush with a shorter bind and hold, and no lasting link.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.timing: Reach within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it costs %4$s PP to cast, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.growth.0: At level %1$s, the squeeze power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.growth.1: At level %1$s, the squeeze power rises to %2$s and the Speed drop to %3$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.preference.l: On: binds and holds far longer and drops one more Speed stage, and keeps a vine connecting both ends that can be torn apart or cut off by a wall, but deals less damage and the user commits limbs to hold it, unable to move for a moment. Off (squeeze): a heavier, quicker crush with a shorter bind and hold and no lasting link.
worldcombat.skill.constrict.preference.a: It will not reach out beyond this distance; it closes in first. This is a close grapple, so a larger value mostly invites misses while chasing.
On: fast-moving or fleeing targets rank higher, so it pins them down first. Off: it only ranks by threat and distance.
